verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a general disputes process page (docs-26) but no API endpoints for retrieving disputes, assembling evidence, or submitting responses, and the AgentOS/CLI 'skills' list (contract-to-billing, beneficiary creation, card provisioning, cashflow management) never mentions disputes as a supported agent workflow. Missing for 10: dispute-retrieval API, evidence-assembly workflow, dispute-response submission API, and any AgentOS/CLI skill or MCP tool covering disputes end-to-end.
